source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U03: Apply surety subrogation,security protection,misrepresentation and reimbursement

payload.title: Payment creates rights,but not a licence to recover any amount
payload.core_explanation_md:
A surety who performs the covered obligation obtains the described subrogation position and can seek the amounts rightfully paid under the implied indemnity. An unnecessary overpayment is not automatically recoverable from the principal debtor. Preserve the demand,coverage,payment and costs basis.

The surety also has the stated benefit of creditor-held security,and its loss can affect liability to the extent of the relevant value. Creditor misrepresentation or concealment of material circumstances has its own validity consequences. These are separate analyses:security loss,discharge,wrongful overpayment and fraudulent procurement should not be entered as one unexplained adjustment.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a surety automatically recover a knowingly wrongful overpayment from the principal debtor?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The source distinguishes rightful from wrongful payment.
